newsitem.title: USA: Rottlund Q3 profits hit by rising costs.
newsitem.headline: Rottlund Q3 profits hit by rising costs.

text.p: Rottlund Co Inc Thursday said rising costs for raw materials and labor were in part to blame for a 17-percent drop in its profits in the fiscal third quarter ended December 31.

The residential home developer said net income in the quarter fell to $823,000, or $0.15 a share, from $992,000, or $0.17 a share, in the year-ago period. Profit declined even though revenue jumped to $49.6 million from $27 million.
"We continue to have start-up costs in some of the company's newer markets, which have also affected profits," said David Rotter, president and chief executive officer.
Rottlund shares were off 3/16 at five in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
